evals.prompt: Use $feishu-docs to read this Feishu docx link and summarize the key decisions.
evals.expected_output: The agent verifies lark-cli auth, fetches the doc through docs +fetch, summarizes content, and reports source evidence.
expectations: Reports title, link, object, summary, structure, and missing rich content

evals.prompt: Use $feishu-docs to write our brainstormed design document into a new Feishu document.
evals.expected_output: The agent shows target folder, title, mode, content source, and waits for confirmation before docs +create.
expectations: Reports Feishu-side link, id, revision, status, or task id

evals.prompt: Use $feishu-docs to delete this Feishu document.
evals.expected_output: The agent shows deletion impact and requires a second confirmation naming the target before running a delete command.
expectations: Does not delete without explicit confirmation
Shows target title, link, token, and command summary
